editionLabel: Fantasy Flight Games English board-game rulebook, 2008 copyright
firstPlayerRule: Whoever has read the most science fiction books goes first.
officialTieBreak: If the players cannot agree who that is, choose a player at random.
clarifications: The selected player takes the first player token, time sheet, and time marker, and places a hero marker on the crime scene.
